meta.title: Talea — Everything in China. One partner.
meta.description: Sourcing, quality control, shipping and warehousing out of China — handled by one accountable team on the ground.

hero.subtitle: Sourcing, quality control, shipping and warehousing — handled by one team on the ground.
hero.badge1: Team on the ground in China

process.heading: Where does it begin?
process.subtitleWide: Seven steps between a thought and a pallet in your warehouse. You are told where you are at every one of them.
process.subtitleNarrow: Seven steps between a thought and a pallet in your warehouse.

steps.title: Everything begins with an idea
steps.body: A product, a market, a hunch. You tell us what you want to sell and who you sell it to.

steps.title: We help you narrow it down
steps.body: Specs, materials, packaging and a target landed price — we turn the idea into a brief a factory can quote.

steps.title: We find the right source
steps.body: We shortlist verified factories, visit and audit them on the ground, and bring you comparable quotes instead of promises.

steps.title: We negotiate, contract, and place your order
steps.body: Price, terms, samples and payment protection agreed in writing before anything is made.

steps.title: We coordinate delivery, QC, and prepare for shipment
steps.body: In-line and pre-shipment inspection, then consolidation, labelling and every export document signed off.

steps.title: Your goods are on the way
steps.body: Sea, rail or air. Booking, insurance and tracking handled, with customs cleared at both ends.

steps.title: You receive what you were waiting for
steps.body: Delivered to your warehouse or held in ours. What you approved is what arrives.

who.heading: A partner, not a middleman
who.midText: Sourcing from China is easy to start and hard to trust. Talea replaces the chain of brokers, agents and forwarders with one accountable team that is physically there — in the factory, at the port, and on the paperwork.
who.midSub: Offices in Shanghai. Sourcing staff and inspectors across Guangdong, Zhejiang and Fujian.

testimonial.quote: Talea are our eyes and ears in China. Reliable, responsive, and genuinely invested in our success.
testimonial.name: Mike Morgan

services.heading: Where are you starting from?
services.subtitle: Pick the situation that sounds like yours.

scenarios.label: I'm sourcing for the first time
scenarios.headline: We take you from idea to first container
scenarios.body: You have a product in mind and no supply chain behind it. We turn the idea into a technical brief, find and audit candidate factories, and walk you through samples, terms and shipping so nothing is a surprise.
points: Sample rounds managed end to end

scenarios.label: I already have a supplier
scenarios.headline: We become your team on the ground
scenarios.body: Keep the factory you trust. We handle the parts that are hard from a distance: production follow-up, inspection before money moves, consolidation, export documents and freight.

scenarios.label: I want to build my own brand
scenarios.headline: Private label, from packaging to pallet
scenarios.body: We match your product spec to factories that can hold it, manage artwork, packaging and compliance marks, and keep your suppliers separated from your customers.

scenarios.label: I need QC & inspection
scenarios.headline: Eyes in the factory before you pay
scenarios.body: Our inspectors work to your checklist — during production and before shipment — and you get a photo-documented report while there is still time to fix things.

scenarios.label: I need warehousing only
scenarios.headline: Store, consolidate and release on your schedule
scenarios.body: Hold stock in China while you consolidate orders from several suppliers, then release shipments when your market needs them rather than when the factory finishes.

cta.heading: Ready to source with confidence?
cta.subtitle: Tell us what you want to sell. We come back with sources, real prices and a plan to get it to your warehouse.
cta.note: No obligation. A reply within one working day.

footer.tagline: Moving goods, building trust. End-to-end sourcing, quality control and logistics out of China.

contactHub.heading: How would you like to reach us?
contactHub.subtitle: Pick whichever fits — a quick message, or a guided form that adapts to your industry and the services you need.

options.title: Quick contact
options.description: One page, a few fields. Best when you already know what you want to ask.

options.title: Detailed request
options.description: A short guided form that adapts to your industry and the services you need, so TALEA gets the full picture upfront.

quickForm.intro: Tell us how we can help. Send your message and, if useful, attach any relevant documents, photos, or specifications.

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: Tell us what you need, what you are trying to achieve, and any important details.

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.title: Upload files or photos
attachments.copy: Optional · Up to 5 files · 10 MB each · JPG, PNG, WEBP, PDF, Word, Excel or CSV
attachments.errorTooMany: Please select no more than 5 files.

success.heading: Message sent.
success.body: Thank you for contacting TALEA. Your inquiry has been received.

step0.heading: Who are we speaking with?
step0.intro: Start with the essentials. Extra contact details and addresses are optional and can be added whenever they are useful.

emails.heading: Email addresses
emails.description: Add another email for a colleague, accounting contact, purchasing department, or another useful point of contact.

phones.heading: Phone numbers
phones.description: One number is enough to start. Add WhatsApp, office, purchasing, or another contact if helpful.

addresses.heading: Addresses
addresses.description: You can add another address, for example a delivery address, warehouse, billing address, or branch. You can also do this later.

step1.heading: Tell us about your business.
step1.intro: This helps TALEA understand the commercial context and ask better questions about sourcing, QC, purchasing, warehousing, and shipping.

industry.heading: Field of business
industry.description: Choose the closest category. We use this to show only the most relevant follow-up questions.
industry.otherLabel: Please specify your field of business
industry.otherPlaceholder: e.g. toys, automotive parts, food packaging

options.label: Fashion & apparel
options.description: Clothing, shoes, bags, accessories and textile products.

options.label: Electronics
options.description: Consumer electronics, accessories, components and devices.

options.label: Home & furniture
options.description: Furniture, lighting, décor, household and lifestyle goods.

options.label: Beauty & care
options.description: Cosmetics, packaging, beauty tools and personal care.

options.label: Industrial
options.description: Machinery, tools, production equipment and technical items.

options.label: Other
options.description: Tell us the category in the next step and we will adapt from there.

step2.heading: What do you need help with?
step2.intro: Select everything that applies. Your next step will automatically change so we only ask about the selected services.

allService.label: A–Z / Full service
allService.description: Select the complete workflow. This automatically selects every service below.

options.label: Sourcing
options.description: Find suppliers, products, factories, alternatives and quotations.

options.label: Supplier verification
options.description: Check a supplier, factory, company or product before committing.

options.label: Purchasing & payment
options.description: Order execution, supplier payment and commercial coordination.

options.label: Quality control
options.description: Check quantity, quality, packaging, visible defects and specifications.

options.label: Warehousing
options.description: Receive, store, organize, consolidate or prepare goods in China.

options.label: Shipping / delivery
options.description: Air, sea or rail transport from China to the final destination.

step2.note: You do not need to know the exact service mix. Select what seems relevant and TALEA can adjust the scope after reviewing your request.

step3.heading: A few details about the request.
step3.intro: This page is generated from your previous answers. It keeps the request short while collecting the details that have the highest operational value.

fashion.heading: Fashion & apparel
fashion.intro: Only the category and product maturity matter at this stage.

status.label: Product status
options: I already have exact products / suppliers
I have references but need sourcing
I only have the concept / specification

electronics.heading: Electronics
electronics.intro: We mainly need to know whether the product is standard or customized and whether compliance is relevant.

certification.label: Compliance / certification
certification.placeholder: e.g. CE, FCC, RoHS — if known

home.heading: Home & furniture
home.intro: Large items are mainly affected by dimensions, materials, and shipment volume.

beauty.heading: Beauty & personal care
beauty.intro: Tell us whether the request concerns finished goods, private label, or packaging.

machinery.heading: Machinery & industrial
machinery.intro: Technical requirements matter more than marketing categories.

sourcing.heading: Sourcing
sourcing.intro: We only need enough information to understand the target product and commercial range.

verification.heading: Supplier verification
verification.intro: If you already know the supplier, give us a name or link. Detailed documents can come later.

purchasing.heading: Purchasing & payment
purchasing.intro: We need a rough order value and whether supplier terms are already agreed.

qc.heading: Quality control
qc.intro: Tell us when goods are expected and what matters most.

warehousing.heading: Warehousing
warehousing.intro: We mainly need to know why the goods need to stay in the warehouse.

shipping.heading: Shipping / delivery
shipping.intro: Destination has the biggest impact at this stage. Cargo measurements can be confirmed later.

attachments.heading: Files & media
attachments.description: Upload product photos, specifications, quotations, supplier documents, drawings, spreadsheets, or other useful references.
attachments.title: Add pictures or files
attachments.copy: Up to 10 files · 10 MB each · 30 MB total. Images, PDF, Word, Excel, CSV and TXT.
attachments.errorTooMany: Please select no more than 10 files.
attachments.errorTotalTooLarge: The combined upload is larger than 30 MB.

step4.heading: What should we optimize for?
step4.intro: A few commercial signals help us prioritize the right service level and avoid asking unnecessary operational questions.

timeline.label: When do you want to start?

notes.label: Anything important we should know?
notes.placeholder: Special product requirements, current supplier problems, target deadlines, preferred way of working, or anything else that helps us understand the request.

step5.heading: Review your request.
step5.intro: This is the information TALEA would receive. You can go back and change anything before submitting.
step5.note: Submitting this prototype does not send data anywhere. In production, connect the final handler to your CRM, API route, or lead management system.

step6.heading: Your request is ready.
step6.body: The adaptive form captured the core lead profile, service needs, industry-specific context, and commercial fit without forcing the customer through irrelevant questions.
